author: Antiben
title: HMI small text after update
op_text:
Hi,



I am using a CPU 1516F-3 PN/DP with four TP1200 Comfort HMIs. I was going to do a minor update to a faceplate controlling just one specific popup screen. I added one I/O field and one text field, saved it and downloaded it to one of the HMIs. After said download all numerical values became hashtags(###).



I started to search for the problem and found that the date and time had been resetted. I fixed that and then every number was correct, but there was a new problem. Now most of the text and numbers on all screens were way smaller than before. I can verify to 95% that this only affects text and numbers within other faceplates. I have buttons and such that still are the correct size, but a lot of other things are extremely small to the point of me being able to read them.



I downloaded an older version just to verify that they are the same, and the actual font size, Tahoma, 9px, style=Bold is the same on both versions. I checked the actual faceplate version and they are the same too. Other settings are also the same, so I am just stumped with what the problem actually might be.



Is there anyone who might know what this problem is and how to fix it?
technician_version: I have a Siemens S7-1500 CPU 1516F-3 PN/DP running four SIMATIC TP1200 Comfort HMI panels. I made a small change to one faceplate's popup (added one I/O field and one text field) and downloaded it to just one panel. Right after the download every numeric value showed as ###. The panel's date and time had been reset; fixing that brought the numbers back, but now most text and numbers inside faceplates on every screen are much smaller than before, while buttons look normal. The font (Tahoma 9px bold) and faceplate version are identical to the older project version. What causes faceplate text to shrink like this after a download, and how do I get it back to the right size?
